title: Principle 2: Focus: sharpen your knife
coreMove: Remove start friction and attention leakage so demanding work gets real contact time.
sourcePressure: Focus concerns starting, sustaining, and protecting concentration from interruption without making the setup itself the performance. The source sidecar contains no named people, studies, institutions, places, dates, or artifacts for this chapter, so named source anchors must be omitted rather than invented.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing focus to aesthetics, timers, or heroic willpower while the task never gets uninterrupted contact.

hook: Ch5: learner stares at browser tabs and realizes motivation is not enough
Ch5: broad modern world pressure opener
counterintuition: The obvious move is not the real move

This is not about working harder

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: Rachel, a financial-aid officer protecting a morning database block
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next month produces visible evidence or another private feeling of effort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rachel closes email and starts the financial-aid database task before any student requests can split the morning block.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a locked inbox icon beside a federal-aid error code sheet

skillTargets: diagnose start friction versus sustained-attention leakage
choose environmental changes that protect task contact

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'
